mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_id, a.aircraft_id, s.departure_airport_id, s.arrival_airport_id, s.departure_datetime, s.arrival_datetime, st.price, a.aircraft_name FROM schedule_templates st JOIN aircrafts a ON st.aircraft_id = a.aircraft_id JOIN schedules s ON st.template_id = s.template_id WHERE s.departure_airport_id = #{departureAirportId} AND s.arrival_airport_id = #{arrivalAirportId} AND s.departure_datetime >= #{departureStartDatetime} AND s.departure_datetime < #{departureEndDatetime} AND s.status != #{cancelledStatus} AND a.is_deleted = FALSE AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_seats ss WHERE ss.schedule_id = s.schedule_id AND ss.status = #{availableStatus} ) >= #{passengerCount} ORDER BY s.departure_datetime ASC
